Res.Caption: Bank Account
Res.FullDescription: Enter the Bank Account Code or Select from the Bank Account Code Listing of which this check book is linked to.

Res.Caption: Auto Print Check
Res.FullDescription: Tick if checks are in A4 size with remittance section. (Not implemented yet).

Res.Caption: Check Book Code
Res.FullDescription: Enter the Code of up to 10 alphanumeric characters.

Res.Caption: Check Book Description
Res.FullDescription: Enter a short description for this check book. It is recommended that you indicate the bank name, currency and check number range for easy identification.

Res.Caption: Branch Code
Res.FullDescription: Enter the Branch Code or Select from the Branch Code Listing of which this check book will be used.
